lead.title: What is a lead
lead.body: A business with its contact details. Find your first in 5 steps.
lead.bodyRepeat: Review the search in 5 steps, with a 5-lead batch.

keywords.title: Choose what to search
keywords.body: Type the business type, e.g. “accounting firms”.

location.title: Choose where to search
location.body: Pick the country. State and city are optional.

count.title: Quantity: 1
count.body: Your first search brings 1 lead for 2 credits.

launch.title: Launch the search
launch.failed: No results. Change the keyword or area.

results.title: Your result
results.body: Your lead is in the table. Export or analyze it.
results.bodyRepeat: Your leads are in the table. Export or analyze them.

intro.title: Meet Leadtita
intro.body: Your sales assistant: finds leads, logs contacts and drafts messages.

ask.title: Ask for leads
ask.body: E.g. “Find me 5 real estate agencies in Córdoba, Argentina”.
ask.hint: If she asks something, answer in the chat.

confirm.title: Confirm the search
confirm.body: Check what she'll search and the cost.

results.title: Leads ready
results.body: They're in your history. Keep going in the chat.
